title: 2 两数相加
code:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def addTwoNumbers(self, l1: Optional[ListNode], l2: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        # 把l2加到l1上
        cur1, cur2 = l1, l2
        while cur1.next != None and cur2.next != None:
            cur1.val += cur2.val
            cur1 = cur1.next
            cur2 = cur2.next
        if cur1.next == None:
            cur1.next = cur2.next
        cur1.val += cur2.val

        # flatten
        cur1 = l1
        while cur1:
            if cur1.val >= 10:
                if cur1.next:
                    cur1.next.val += cur1.val // 10
                else:
                    cur1.next = ListNode(cur1.val // 10)
                cur1.val %= 10
            cur1 = cur1.next

        return l1
